diameter.name: 呼び径
diameter.comment: ねじの呼び径（M8なら8）。ねじ山はこの値に合わせて自動で決まる

length.name: 長さ
length.comment: 首下長さ（M8x20なら20）。頭の下から先端まで

thread_length.name: ねじ部長さ
thread_length.comment: ねじ部長さ b（JIS B 1180 / ISO 4014）: 長さ125以下は 2×呼び径+6、125超200以下は 2×呼び径+12、200超は 2×呼び径+25。長さ以上なら全ねじ

chamfer_angle.name: 面取り角度
chamfer_angle.comment: 頭の上面の角を落とす面取りの角度。上面から測る

diameter.name: diameter
diameter.comment: Nominal diameter (M8 = 8). The thread size follows this value automatically

length.name: length
length.comment: Length under the head (M8x20 = 20), from under the head to the tip

thread_length.name: thread_length
thread_length.comment: Thread length b (ISO 4014 / JIS B 1180): length up to 125: 2d+6, over 125 up to 200: 2d+12, over 200: 2d+25. At or above length: fully threaded

across_flats.name: across_flats
across_flats.comment: Hex width across flats s (ISO 4014 / JIS B 1180): M3=5.5 M4=7 M5=8 M6=10 M8=13 M10=16 M12=18 M16=24 M20=30

chamfer_angle.name: chamfer_angle
chamfer_angle.comment: Angle of the chamfer on the head's top corners, measured from the top face
